data.title: Passport Mela Nov 21: 4,000 Hyderabad slots, booking from Nov 3
data.body: RPO Hyderabad holds a special Passport Mela on Saturday, Nov 21. About 4,000 appointments for normal, Tatkaal passports and PCCs. Booking opens Nov 3 at designated PSKs and POPSKs.
means: Need a passport or PCC? Book from Nov 3
data.care: Book from Nov 3 on the Passport Seva portal.

steps.e: Booking opens at PSKs and POPSKs

data.title: Murasu lands tonight; Hyderabad–Vijayawada flights cancelled
data.body: IMD: landfall between Nellore and Narsapur, 11:30 pm Mon to 4 am Tue, gusts up to 120 kmph. 12 Vijayawada flights are off, including Hyderabad routes. Six Telangana districts are on orange alert today; Hyderabad is not.
means: Flying HYD–Vijayawada or Vizag today? Check your airline
Nagarkurnool: avoid Somasila, Nallamalla ghat road. Helpline 08540-230201
Orange districts: Khammam, Mahabubnagar, Nalgonda, Suryapet, Nagarkurnool, Wanaparthy
Travelling to coastal AP Nov 2–3? Check train and bus status
Farmers: cover harvested paddy with tarpaulins
data.care: Check your district's IMD warning before travelling today.

data.title: No tap water 6 am Tue to 6 pm Wed in Nampally, Mallepally, Banjara Hills
data.body: HMWSSB is plugging major leaks in the Gandipet conduit near Sabza Colony, Tolichowki and Manikonda. Supply stops for 36 hours from 6 am Nov 3 to 6 pm Nov 4 in parts of Golconda zone, Kavadiguda and Banjara Hills.
means: Store two days of drinking water by Monday night
Areas: Red Hills, Nampally, Mallepally, Asif Nagar, Domalguda, Banjara Hills ward and more
HMWSSB asks everyone to use water sparingly
data.care: Fill tanks and store water by Monday night.

data.title: Bhadrachalam's new Godavari bridge closed till Nov 7 for load tests
data.body: The new high-level bridge over the Godavari at Bhadrachalam is shut to vehicles from Oct 31 to Nov 7 for load testing. Traffic goes over the old bridge, police said.
means: Driving to Bhadrachalam this week? Expect the old bridge route

steps.e: New Godavari bridge shut to vehicles
Closure ends; old bridge carries traffic till then

data.care: Plan for the old bridge if you're driving to Bhadrachalam before Nov 8.

data.title: IIIT Junction road stays shut 3 more months from Oct 27
data.body: Cyberabad Traffic Police extended the closure between DLF Gate No. 1 and Gachibowli Traffic PS by 3 months from Oct 27. It's for the IIIT Junction multi-level flyover, which could take at least a year.
means: Diversions stay in place till late January
Add buffer time on Gachibowli–HITEC City runs

steps.b: Works may run at least a year.

steps.e: Flyover works may take at least a year

data.care: Use the diversions and leave early tomorrow.
